name: Lustful Choices
source:
This VN follows the story of a teenage boy. He is tired of his mundane life; he has never experienced the touch of a woman because of his introverted nature and inability to reach out to others for the comfort he desires through sexual pleasure and the warmth of a loved one, but things take a sudden turn.

As if his faith were rewritten, new people start coming into his life, like a new transfer student, his childhood crush, his roommate, a bully who develops fondness for him over time, and many more people. So many opportunities to improve your life and people around you. Take control of the choices he makes to develop the relationship with them. and choose your beloved, or just play around; the choice is yours.

{From [url=https://chiefstales.itch.io/lustful-choices]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
该视频讲述了一个十几岁男孩的故事。他厌倦了平凡的生活；由于他性格内向，无法通过性快感和亲人的温暖向他人寻求安慰，因此他从未体验过女人的触摸，但事情突然发生了转变。

仿佛他的信仰被重写了，新的人开始进入他的生活，比如一个新的转学生、他儿时的暗恋对象、他的室友、一个随着时间的推移对他产生好感的恶霸，以及更多的人。有很多机会可以改善你的生活和周围的人。控制他为发展与他们的关系而做出的选择。选择你心爱的人，或者只是玩玩；选择权在你。

{来自 [url=https://chiefstales.itch.io/lustful-choices]Itch.io[/url]]
